# nirholas

> Open-source tooling for 3D AI agents, agent payments and on-chain builders. 391 public repositories by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Catalog

- [Full machine-readable list](https://github.com/nirholas/nirholas/blob/main/repos.json): name, description, topics, language and stars for every repo
- [Human catalog](https://github.com/nirholas/nirholas#readme): grouped by topic

## Sections

- Robinhood Chain: 22 repositories
- x402 payments and agent commerce: 83 repositories
- MCP servers for AI agents: 56 repositories
- three.ws platform and 3D agents: 59 repositories
- Solana and pump.fun tooling: 24 repositories
- DeFi mechanisms and Uniswap v4 hooks: 46 repositories
- On-chain experiments and collectibles: 73 repositories
- Developer tools and everything else: 28 repositories
